authority: Normalized from the approved DollarHua visual baseline. Official reference images remain authoritative for rendered appearance.

tokens.name: Signature Pink
tokens.usage: Hoodie, primary soft-pink fields, friendly emphasis, and major brand surfaces.
tokens.restriction: Do not shift the dominant character pink toward saturated magenta or cool purple.

tokens.name: Blossom Pink
tokens.usage: Flower accessories, blush, hearts, sticker lettering, and secondary emphasis.
tokens.restriction: Keep enough contrast from Signature Pink when both colors appear together.

tokens.name: Amber Gold
tokens.usage: Iris base, stars, sparkles, prosperity cues, and warm highlights.
tokens.restriction: Keep eye highlights white; do not replace the amber-gold eye family with green or blue.

tokens.name: Outline Navy
tokens.usage: Primary character line art, dark display text, sticker keylines, and high-contrast accents.
tokens.restriction: Prefer this navy over pure black in core character artwork.

tokens.name: Pendant Bronze
tokens.usage: Round pendant, brown bead bracelet, and controlled metallic-earth accents.
tokens.restriction: Do not replace the pendant with bright yellow gold without a new approved asset version.

tokens.name: Warm Skin
tokens.usage: Skin base and soft warm facial rendering.
tokens.restriction: Keep skin rendering soft and warm; avoid harsh gray shadows.

tokens.name: Soft White
tokens.usage: Hair, ears, clean backgrounds, sticker cutlines, and visual breathing space.
tokens.restriction: Use subtle shading to preserve white forms; do not flatten all white areas into one field.

tokens.name: Contextual Lucky Red
tokens.usage: Limited prosperity, warning, celebration, or feng shui accents when 红色招财 is relevant.
tokens.restriction: Never displace Signature Pink as the primary visual identity color.
